name: The van driver (panel 36)
personality: Background extra: the moving-van driver, waves out of the cab window with the left arm. Never speaks.
voiceNote: gibberish, mid and plain (a proposal until Jonny has heard it)
notes: An everyday potato, an extra (story rule: no fighters as random people). Spud's body, skin, face, glove and costume type `spud` (the knit sweater with rolled collar, hem and cuffs) in his own colour; the elbow patch is set to the sweater colour so it does not read as Spud's. Mustard sweater #b98f54, brown trousers. Wears prop kind `flatcap` (#9a7a4a) via spec.wear. Seat him at the `boxvan` cab seat point; only head, chest and the waving left arm show. Skin #dba15a per DESIGN.
